tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rjer snyan ngag gi bstod pa ka la piṅka gsal bar byas pa bzhugs so//

rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rjer snyan ngag gi bstod pa ka la piṅka gsal ba go bder bshad pa/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum rgyal ba'i lam gyur shing rta'i srol// zab cing rgya che'i gsang ba sā ga ra// brtson pa hub kyis gsol nus a gasta// gnyis skyes khyod mtshan rigs kyi bdag por mchod// mgon po khyod kyi rnam thar mdzad pa'i phul// sa gsum 'gengs pa'i sgra dbyangs dundu bhiḥ /mkhas dbang snyan ngag daṇḍis bskul ba'i bsngags// go bde'i drug skyes mkhas min dga' phyir bshad// de yang zhang zhung pa chos dbang grags pas rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rje la snyan ngag gi bstod pa ka la piṅka zhes bya ba cung zad snyan ngag che zhing sarga dang gleng gzhi mngon brjod brda rnying gis bcings pas go dka' ba'i phyir/ de dag gi snyan ngag gi rgyan rnams gzugs dang sbyor tshul ma nyams par sarga dang mngon brjod la sogs pa go bde ba'i phyir phal tshig tu bshad pa yin/ ka la piṅkar/ grub pa'i dbang phyug khyod mtshan dbyar skyes rnga// thos pas rab dga' myos pa'i gtsug phud can// dad pa'i spu long ches cher rgyas pa yi// bstod tshig zlos gar 'jo sgeg rol pa 'dzin// ces pa ni/ grub dbang khyod kyi mtshan dkar 'brug gi sgra// thos pas rab dga' tshims pa'i rma bya bdag /dad pa'i spu zing yid kyi 'dab gshog dag /skyes pa'i bstod tshigs glu gar 'di brtsams so// zhes pa mtha' dag gzugs can no// ka la piṅkar/ mgon khyod gangs ri'i khrod 'dir tshe gcig la// mngon par sangs rgyas de tshe bod kyi zhing*// 'di ni sa la gnas pa'i 'og min zhes// zhing gzhan dag la gus pa lhod par gyur// ces pa ni/ khyod nyid zhing 'dir tshe gcig la// mngon sangs rgyas mod de yi tshe// bod 'di sa yi 'og min zhes// zhing gzhan dag la gus pa lhod// ces pa phul byung gi rgyan no// ka la piṅkar/

grangs ring bgrod dka'i dregs ldan sangs rgyas lam// dbang phyug khyod kyi gom pa gcig gis ni// bgrod tshe thub bstan stobs ldan sa 'og tu// zhugs par rtogs par rgyal rnams skrag pa 'dzin// zhes pa ni/ bskal mang bgrod par dka' ba'i sangs rgyas lam// khyab 'jug khyod kyis tshe gcig gom pa yis// bgrod tshe thub bstan lha min stobs ldan 'di// sa 'og bros dgos sangs rgyas gzhan rnams bred// ces pa gzugs can la rab btags kyi rgyan gyis sgro btags pas rab spel la sngon gyi gleng gzhi sbyar bas snyan ngag chen mo zhes grags shing*/ 'di'i gleng bzhi ni/ sngon lha min gyi dbang po stobs ldan mchod sbyin byed par khyab 'jug mi'u thung du brdzus nas/ kho bo la sa gom pa gang bslang zhes smras/ lha min dbang pos gom pa gsum dgos kyang sbyin no smras pas/ khyab 'jug gis lus chen por sprul nas rkang pa ya gcig ri rab kyi rtse dang ya gcig rgya mtsho'i steng du bzhag /lha min dbang po la smras pa/ 'di gom pa gang yin/ gom pa do gang du yod ces smras pas/ lha min dbang po skyengs te sa 'og tu bros so zhes rig byed kyi gtam rgyud dang sbyar ba yin no// yang ka la piṅkar/ 'phong rkyen dga' byed mda' yis 'bod sgrog gi// ri dwags mchog de bzung bar ma nus te// khyod kyi snying stobs mtshon chas nyon mongs kyi// sgra sde skad gcig nyid la thal bar brlags// zhes pa ni/ mda' mkhas dga' rab dbang phyug mdas// ri dwags mchog de ma sod par// khyod kyi snying rje'i mtshon cha yis// nyon mongs dgra sde phar la bcom// zhes pa nyams ldan dang yongs brjes kyi rgyan du rtogs pa'o/ ka la piṅkar/ blo gros bai ḍūr dkar po'i bum bzang gis| |nā ro ta pa'i man ngag ga pur gyi// thigs pa bzung ba khyod thugs la reg pas// srid pa'i tsha gdung ming gi lhag mar byas// zhes pa ni/

mar ston blo gros bai ḍūr bum pa'i nang*| |nā ro pa yi man ngag ga pur chus// gang ba'i thigs pa khyod thugs la sims pas// 'khor ba'i tshad rnying ming yang med par byas// zhes pa bsdus pa'i gzugs can no// ka la piṅkar| ba spu snod ldan tshod ma'i dka' thub can// 'di yi mdzub rtse padma'i skud pa yis// mthar byed dpung pa gtum po'ang skyengs byed de// dam chos sgrub rnams skyong ba'i rdzu la brten| |ces pa ni/ zwa tshod kho nas ngal ba khyod sku yi// yan lag padma'i skud pa ltar phra ba// gshin rje la sogs dpung pa stobs ldan rnams// bcom zhes dka' thub byed rnams dbugs 'byin mdzad// ces pa chad dang skabs min bstod pa bsres pa'o// ka la piṅkar/ dka' thub kyis mdzes sen mo'i kha ris ni// gsar pa phra ba'i lus ldan zla tshes kyi// kha zas la sred 'dod yon khur 'chang ba'i// khengs ldan rnams la 'phya bas dgod pa bzhin// zhes pa ni/ tshe 'di'i bde ba khyad bsad dka' thub kyi// ngal bas sha zhum sen mo'i zla tshes 'di// dkar zhing gtsigs pas tshe 'di don gnyer ba'i// chos pa rnams la 'phya phyir dgod pa bzhin// zhes pa ni rab btags bzhin sgra can no// ka la piṅkar| chu srin rgyal mtshan can gyi chu khur can// mnyam bzhag nam mkha'i ngang du zhi gyur pa// de tshe khyod thugs dri bral kun gsal gdong*// sngo bsangs mdzes sdug lang tsho ci yang 'dzin| |ces pa ni/ bdud sde dpung bcas bar gcod sprin tshogs rnams// 'dzin med mnyam bzhag nam mkha'i ngang du zhi// de tshe khyod thugs sgrib bral nam mkha'i khams// ston dus ji bzhin gsal dang rnyog pa bral// zhes pa sbyar ba'i gzugs can no/ */ka la piṅkar/ rdo rje'i sku la dgun dus kha ba yi// reg pas mi rdzi de la ngo mtshar cing*// srid gsum za ba gtum mo'i me chen gyis// tshig par ma nus ras kyi gos de mtshar// zhes pa ni/

khyod sku 'jig med rdo rje'i sku// kha bas ma non ya gcig mtshan// srid gsum za phod gtum mo'i mes// ma tshig ras gos e ma mtshar// zhes pa zol bstod do// ka la piṅkar/ gser ldan dga' ma'i lto bar khyod kyi ni// yon tan phung po mngal khur gyis lci ba// de tshe zla ba'i ma ma ro ldan ma// ngal ba'i dus bzhi'i mtha' la 'bros par rtsom// zhes pa ni/ sa gzhi mdzes pa'i khong par yon tan can// 'di nyid 'dzin pa'i mngal khur gyis lci ba// 'degs pa'i ngal bas rgya mtsho rab bdun nas// bskal pa 'jig pa'i mtha' la 'bros par rtsom// zhes pa gzugs can gyi gzugs can dang rab btags bsres pa'o// ka la piṅkar/ grub pa'i pho nya mkha' 'gro gdong pad kyis// sbrang rtsi btung bas rab myos rkang drug pa// las kyi bser bu rgyun bcad gnyid log pa// sad tshe yid mkha' 'ja' tshon gos kyis khebs// zhes pa ni// tshe ring ma sogs las rgya'i padmo la// snyoms 'jug bde ba'i sbrang rtsis myos pa yis// bung ba khyod ni rlung sems 'od gsal du// gnyid log sad tshe lha sku sgyu mar ldang*// zhes pa sbyar ba'i gzugs can no// ka la piṅkar/ thub gzhung zab don drug skyes sa 'dzin ngogs// glu yis nges bcings chags ldan skye bo 'dis// srid mthar nges sgrog thub bstan dus bzhi ni// 'jig kyang nyams pa med pa khyod kyi drin// zhes pa ni/ thub gzhung kun snying nges don glu dbyangs 'di// skal bzang chags ldan kun gyi rna ba ru// thub bstan 'jig kyang nges don phyag rgya che// ma nyams thos 'di khyod nyid kho na'i drin// zhes gzugs can dang dga' ba'i nyams ldan spel ba'o// ka la piṅkar/ grub mchog mi la mkha' lding dbang po yis// rjes bzung sa 'di skal bzang ras dkar gyi// 'dab gshog can rnams 'phur zhing lding ba yis// gang ba'i sa 'di bya rgod phung po nyid// ces pa ni/

mi la 'dab chags dbang po yi// rjes 'jug grub pa thob pa rnams// ras dkar 'dab mas mkha' la 'phur// sa 'di bya rgod phung ri nyid// ces pa gzugs can nyams ldan no// ka la piṅkar/ ro rgyab rma srol can 'di zung 'jug sku'i// za ma tog tu 'os pa ma yin zhes// dor tshe rang don la gus tshig mda' yis// gtor ba'i 'dab brgya'i phreng bas chung mthong 'gog /ces pa ni/ sku rgyab rma dod rgas 'khogs lus sgrom 'di// yan lag bdun ldan snod du mi 'os zhes// dor tshe lha dang lha min gyis mchod pa'i// me tog phreng bas nam mkha' khengs shing 'gog /ces pa ni rab btags dang rnam grangs brjod pa zur tsam smos pa'o// ka la piṅkar/ mgon khyod gang du mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i// sku dang zhing gi bkod pa nges min yang*// phyogs der rtse gcig yid gtad gnyis 'thung bdag /thugs rje'i lcags kyus lci ba'i dbang gyur cig /ces pa ni/ khyod nyid gang du sangs rgyas pa'i// bkod pa mtha' yas 'das mod kyang*| |der gus yid gtad glang po bdag /thugs rje'i lcags kyus drang du gsol// zhes pa mi mnyam pa'i gzugs can la shis brjod kyi rgyan sbyar ba'o// ka la piṅkar/ de ltar bstod pa'i dge tshogs gzugs su ni// gyur gang nam mkha' 'gengs par byed pa des// skye ba kun tu rgyal ba'i dam chos kun// rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji bzhin 'dzin gyur cig /ces pa go sla yang 'di ltar/ de ltar bstod pa'i dge tshogs rnams// gzugs su grub na mkhas gang ba// skye ba kun tu dam pa'i chos// ji bzhin 'dzin pa nyid gyur cig /ces pa ni phul byung dang*/ rgya che ba dang*/ dgongs pa can gyi rgyan rnams sbyar ba yin no// smras pa/ rje btsun bzhad pa'i ye shes man shel khams// sna tshogs 'gro ba'i tshon brgya dang 'phrad tshe// grangs med zhing dang sprul sku'i rnam rol gar// mkhyen pa lnga rnams cis kyang brjod mi lang*// 'on kyang 'ga' zhig snyan ngag ga ma gas// bcings pa'i drug skyes chos dbang blo gros kyi// gar mkhan ngang mo'i mgrin pa'i rdza rnga las// thos pa go dka'i gnas rnams rab gsal bar// smras 'di chos kyi grags pa'i blo mtsho las// legs par 'ongs pa'i legs bshad dal 'bab yin// rig lam bcu phrag tshogs pa'i blo ldan mtsho// rig gnas legs bshad gdengs can gyis bstan pa'i// rig pa'i lam du legs bshad nyal 'gro'i glu// rig gnas don gnyer rdzongs su 'di bab bo// daṇḍi'i gzhung du don dang sgra gab tshig

/sna tshogs rgyan mang bshad las don rgyan tsam// zhib mor ma btags hol rgyug thos rlom gyi// mngon brjod sgra dang brda dag lung rigs dang*// gsung rab rgya mtsho'i legs bshad cang med par// snyan ngag btsal ba'i khur ldan des bsad pa'i// dka' thub can rnams 'di la ngal stegs mdzod// 'ga' zhig tshig rgyan lam dang mi ldan par// mngon brjod kha mkhas spel ba'i ngan rtsom la// snyan ngag re rnams srin bu'i me 'od kyis// padma'i lag pa'i bya ba byed rlom mtshungs// de phyir mkhas par 'dod rnams mkhas pa yis// mkhas par brtsams 'di mkhas par sbyangs pa na// mkhas pa'i grags thob mkhas par 'gyur ba'i phyir| |mkhas pa'i ngag 'di mkhas 'dod rnams kyis longs// de ltar zhang zhung pa chos dbang grags pas rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rje'i rnam par thar pa 'ga' zhig snyan ngag gi bstod pa ka la piṅka zhes pa cung zad go dka' bar 'dug pas/ snyan ngag gi gzugs ma nyams par don gsal por go ba zhig gyis shig /ces pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i dbang po shar tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyi ring lugs pa gung thang rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas 'byung gnas kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ 'bri gung pa skyu ra'i gdung las dbu ru stod kyi snyan ngag mkhan chos kyi grags pas| dbang phyug gi lo'i smin drug can gyi dkar po'i rdzogs pa gsum par pho brang bkra shis tshugs kyi re'u mig padma 'od du mgyogs par bris pa'o/// /sarba maṅga laṃ//
